facts.fact: Third-party FAQ restructuring guidance (Zigpoll) recommends starting with the top 10 frequent questions from support data.
facts.quote: starting with the **top 10 frequent questions** from support data

facts.fact: Third-party best-practice guidance (Red Arrow Marketing) recommends that FAQ answers start with a short, direct response of about 40 to 60 words.
facts.quote: start with a **short, direct response of about 40 to 60 words**

facts.fact: The Adwave article was published on May 26, 2026.
FAQ schema is structured code that tells search engines that a page contains questions and answers, according to Adwave.
facts.quote: It's structured code that tells search engines, “This page contains questions and answers.”

facts.fact: The Adwave article recommends reviewing recurring FAQ questions monthly.
facts.quote: Review recurring questions monthly. Add new ones quickly. Retire outdated answers.
